title: dsamoht/roshab-cli pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample_id.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

group.errorMessage: Group name must be provided and cannot contain spaces. Samples sharing a group are summarised together and, with --coassemble_by_group, assembled together

info.errorMessage: Sampling site (or any free-text label used in the figures) must be provided and cannot contain spaces

date.errorMessage: Sampling date must be provided and cannot contain spaces

reads.errorMessage: Nanopore reads must be provided: either a FastQ file (optionally gzipped) or a directory of FastQ files, which are concatenated before processing
